scope: Home at a 390px-class true browser viewport

evidenceBoundary.observedBlockingFact: The live Demo preview measured 10px wide and the Home canvas measured 0px wide, so no Home section was auditable at the true narrow viewport.
evidenceBoundary.touchTargetEvidence: unavailable because the Demo canvas collapsed; the minimum below is an implementation acceptance requirement, not an observed source measurement

A_demoHostPreview.scope: Demo host and preview integration only; this is inspection infrastructure, not ONE PIECE brand content
requirements: Switch to full-width mobile inspection mode before the reference navigation and workspace can consume the preview width.
The preview and Home canvas must each expose a non-zero usable width; at the audited 390px class they must fill the available viewport width after only intentional outer safe insets.
Reference-site navigation, left rails, inspectors and split panes must move above, collapse, become overlays, or be hidden; they must never leave the preview at 10px or the canvas at 0px.
The page document must be vertically scrollable when content exceeds the viewport; the host must not lock the full Home page into an 800px shell.
Desktop may retain the phone mockup shell. At a true narrow viewport the mockup shell must be removed from layout or made dimension-neutral so the content is inspected full-width.
Device bezel, speaker, notch, shadow and shell chrome are presentation aids only and must never be interpreted, inventoried or scored as brand content.

measurableAcceptance.previewWidth: greater than 0 and no less than viewport width minus 32px total intentional inset
measurableAcceptance.homeCanvasWidth: greater than 0 and equal to preview content width
measurableAcceptance.documentScrollHeight: must exceed viewport height for the full Home page
measurableAcceptance.sectionVisibility: navigation/Hero, Welcome, News/New Arrival, Products/Events/mid-page and Footer must each yield visible same-viewport pixels
measurableAcceptance.touchTargetMinimum: 44x44 CSS px for actionable controls unless later source measurement proves a different accessible geometry

forbidden: desktop split layout preserved at the cost of preview usability
scaled desktop phone shell treated as proof of true responsive behavior
device shell counted as source composition or brand asset

B_homeMobileReflow.scope: Home content inside the exposed preview canvas

globalRules.width: Every section owns the 390px content viewport; section backgrounds may be full bleed, while readable content uses evidence-aligned insets.
globalRules.columnReorder: Desktop multi-column arrangements must become readable vertical stacks or mobile rows without deleting the defining hierarchy or density pattern.
globalRules.crop: Crop is allowed only for explicitly masked media/rails; it must not create document-level horizontal overflow or clip copy and controls.
globalRules.typography: Preserve the approved display/editorial/body/metadata role separation; responsive sizing and wrapping may change, but roles may not collapse into one face or one level.
globalRules.touch: All interactive controls require at least 44x44 CSS px hit area pending exact same-viewport source measurements.
overflowForbidden: document scrollWidth greater than viewport width
section content escaping its clipping boundary
text, navigation or controls clipped to simulate desktop composition
scale-only treatment where the evidence classifies true-reflow
hidden sections used to shorten the page

sections.widthAndGeometry: Use a compact approximately 64.5px full-width header with an approximately 141.4x36.5px logo, followed by a full-width Hero.
sections.columnReorder: Desktop navigation must collapse into a mobile control pattern without shrinking the Hero canvas; the active campaign remains the dominant first content.
sections.crop: Inactive carousel slides may be masked off-viewport inside the Hero rail; the active slide and its essential campaign hierarchy remain legible.
sections.typography: Hero catch target is approximately 19.76px while retaining campaign hierarchy and condensed metadata separation.
sections.touch: Menu and carousel actions expose >=44x44 CSS px hit areas.

sections.widthAndGeometry: Full-width section; primary heading wraps in an approximately 332.8px box with approximately 28.6px side insets.
sections.columnReorder: Narrative, supporting media and CTA become a readable vertical flow while preserving the onboarding invitation hierarchy.
sections.crop: No copy or CTA crop; decorative media may use bounded crop only if text remains unaffected.
sections.typography: Editorial heading approximately 32.24px and movie heading approximately 20.8px; keep serif narrative prominence distinct from utility text.
sections.touch: Welcome CTA hit area >=44px high and >=44px wide; hover-only feedback cannot be the sole mobile affordance.

sections.widthAndGeometry: News rows reflow within the viewport; New Arrival is a bounded full-width rail containing approximately 166.4px items.
sections.columnReorder: News metadata, title and media reorder into scan-friendly mobile rows; New Arrival preserves horizontal item sequencing rather than becoming an unrelated grid.
sections.crop: The New Arrival rail may mask its next/previous items at its own boundary; the document itself must remain 390px wide.
sections.typography: News titles remain approximately 14.04-16.64px; the New Arrival section title remains approximately 34.32px and visually dominant.
sections.touch: Row links and rail controls expose >=44x44 CSS px targets; adjacent items must not create overlapping hit areas.

sections.widthAndGeometry: Products categories stack as mobile rows. Event rows stack vertically at approximately 373.4px width, leaving an approximately 8.3px side inset at 390px.
sections.columnReorder: Preserve product-first scanning; Events keep image/text composition inside each vertical row. Schedule, Recommend and Videos continue as visible vertically ordered modules rather than being omitted.
sections.crop: Product and event media may use bounded object-fit crop while keeping the merchandise/event subject and adjacent text legible; mid-page controls and text may not crop.
sections.typography: Products display title approximately 53.04px, product row titles approximately 16.64px, event titles approximately 15.6px; short display type remains distinct from row titles and metadata.
sections.touch: Each row/card action and any carousel/video control exposes >=44x44 CSS px hit area.

sections.widthAndGeometry: Footer fills the mobile viewport; structural footer navigation is approximately 343.2px wide with approximately 23.4px side insets.
sections.columnReorder: Footer navigation and legal/utility groups stack into readable mobile order; the approved page-closing illustration remains before, and distinct from, the navy structural footer.
sections.crop: Only bounded outer decorative overscan may crop; navigation, legal copy, logo and semantic illustration layers may not be lost.
sections.typography: Observed footer base is approximately 8.32px, but implementation must preserve legibility and hierarchy; do not enlarge it into a competing display role or treat this observation as permission for inaccessible controls.
sections.touch: Footer links require >=44px hit-area height even when visible glyphs remain compact.
forbidden: footer as plain navy substitute for the illustration organism
device shell merged into footer artwork

allowedTransformations: desktop mockup shell retained above the true-narrow breakpoint
vertical stacking and mobile row reordering
responsive type size/line-height within the observed hierarchy
bounded media crop and masked New Arrival/Hero rails
safe inset adjustment within the evidence tolerances
forbiddenTransformations: claiming source fidelity from a desktop phone mockup alone
treating host chrome or a device shell as ONE PIECE brand content
using scale-only compression for source sections classified true-reflow
removing content to avoid vertical scrolling
inventing exact source touch-target measurements before recapture

steps: Recapture source and Demo at the exact same 390x844 CSS viewport after the host canvas is exposed.
Record preview, canvas, section and interactive bounding boxes.
Prove document scrollWidth <= viewport width and full-page vertical scrolling works.
Classify every section as true-reflow, scale, crop or overflow and reject any accidental overflow.
Measure touch targets; replace the provisional 44px acceptance floor only with captured source evidence plus an accessibility-safe decision.

unresolved: Exact source touch-target boxes remain unresolved until same-viewport recapture.
Footer same-viewport Demo parity remains unresolved until the host collapse is fixed.
